external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A member of the grocery loyalty programme who uses the mobile app and browser to collect points, redeem gift cards, and manage connected partner apps.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members collect points when they shop and spend them on gift cards.

external_entities.name: partner app
external_entities.description: A web application operated by another company, such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

external_entities.name: browser
external_entities.description: The browser used by a member to sign in to the authorization server and return to a partner app redirect URI.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.
external_entities.notes: Its execution location is not stated.

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application through which members sign in, call the rewards API, and disconnect partner apps.

processes.name: authorization server
processes.description: The server that authenticates members, issues authorization codes and tokens, handles consent, and supports partner app registration.
processes.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow

processes.name: rewards API
processes.description: The API that reads and writes the points ledger and supports point redemption for gift cards.
processes.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

processes.name: support console
processes.description: A web application that closes a member's account.
processes.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.

data_stores.name: identity database
data_stores.description: The database containing member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, consents, and account-closure state.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database

data_stores.name: points ledger
data_stores.description: The ledger holding every member's balance and every points transaction, including the client that made each change.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the points ledger, which holds every member's balance and every points transaction

data_stores.name: API log store
data_stores.description: The store receiving every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: use mobile app
data_flows.description: A member uses the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members use our mobile app.
data_flows.data_description: Member interaction with the mobile app

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: The mobile app signs the member in through the authorization server using the authorization code flow.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow
data_flows.notes: The source says it is not recorded whether the app sends a PKCE challenge.
data_flows.data_description: Authorization requests, authorization codes, access tokens, and refresh tokens

data_flows.name: call rewards API
data_flows.description: The mobile app calls the rewards API with an access token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back
data_flows.data_description: Access token and rewards requests involving points

data_flows.name: sign-in browser
data_flows.description: A member signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in a browser and approves consent.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser and approves a consent screen
data_flows.data_description: Member sign-in credentials and consent selections

data_flows.name: return authorization code
data_flows.description: The browser returns an authorization code to the partner app's redirect URI.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.

data_flows.name: token request
data_flows.description: A partner app sends token requests using its client secret.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The partner app sends that secret in the body of its token requests.

data_flows.name: show points
data_flows.description: A partner app shows a member's points using the rewards API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points
data_flows.notes: The source does not explicitly describe the partner app's API call.

data_flows.name: store identity data
data_flows.description: The authorization server stores and retrieves member identity and authorization data in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database, together with the authorization codes, refresh tokens and consents it issues.
data_flows.data_description: Accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, consents, and account status

data_flows.name: update points ledger
data_flows.description: The rewards API reads and writes balances and point transactions in the points ledger.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

data_flows.name: write request logs
data_flows.description: The rewards API writes every received request and its headers to the API log store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: close account
data_flows.description: A member uses the support console to close their account.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.

data_flows.name: mark account closed
data_flows.description: The support console marks a member account closed in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Closing an account marks it closed in the identity database.

data_flows.name: disconnect partner app
data_flows.description: The mobile app requests disconnection of a partner app, causing its refresh token to be deleted from the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members can disconnect a partner app from the settings screen of the mobile app
data_flows.data_description: Partner-app disconnection request and refresh-token deletion

trust_boundaries.name: own cloud
trust_boundaries.description: The organization's own cloud account where the platform components and stores run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Everything below runs in our own cloud account

trust_boundaries.name: member device
trust_boundaries.description: The members' phones, which are outside the organization's cloud account.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: apart from the members' phones and the partner apps
trust_boundaries.notes: The browser's execution zone is not explicitly stated.

trust_boundaries.name: partner server
trust_boundaries.description: Servers operated by other companies for their partner applications.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: partner apps that other companies run on their own servers

assumptions.assumption: The identity database contains confidential data because it holds member personal data, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the store holds member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.

assumptions.assumption: The points ledger contains confidential data because it holds member balances and transactions tied to members.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the ledger holds every member's balance and every points transaction.

assumptions.assumption: The API log store contains confidential data because request headers may contain bearer credentials and requests may concern members and rewards.
assumptions.basis: The source states that every request, including headers, is written to the log store.

assumptions.assumption: The rewards API is internet-facing because the support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

assumptions.assumption: The support console is internet-facing because it is served on a public hostname.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.
